name: Open Ownership
tagline: Driving global shift towards transparency and accountability in corporate ownership and control
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on government adoption and political will for implementation
Dependency on international funding for operations
news_articles: Guardian: 'Open Ownership launches beneficial ownership transparency initiative'
Reuters: 'Global push for corporate ownership transparency gains momentum'
TechCrunch: 'Open Ownership secures funding for beneficial ownership database'
academic_citations: Sharman, J. C. (2017). 'The Despot's Dilemma: The Political Economy of Extraterritoriality.' Cornell University Press.
Findley, M. G., et al. (2021). 'The Illicit Global Economy and State Power.' Journal of Politics.
awards: Transparency International Award for Anti-Corruption Innovation

policy_outcomes.description: Senegal expanded beneficial ownership declarations and advanced legal reforms for public access with support from Opening Extractives
Philippines improving availability and use of beneficial ownership data in extractive governance
Partnership with Zambia's Patents and Company Registration Agency (PACRA) to overhaul beneficial ownership data collection

outcome_methodology: Mixed methods including government adoption tracking, policy analysis, and stakeholder interviews
published_performance_metrics: Annual impact reports tracking beneficial ownership register implementations and policy adoptions
documented_limitations: Variation in government capacity and political will to implement reforms
Data quality and completeness challenges across jurisdictions
Limited enforcement mechanisms in some countries
failure_modes: Limited adoption in countries with weak governance institutions
Resistance from private sector stakeholders concerned about disclosure requirements
curation_criteria: Focus on beneficial ownership transparency standards, alignment with EITI and international anti-corruption frameworks
contributor_governance: Multi-stakeholder governance including government representatives, civil society, and private sector participants
disparity_tracking: Monitoring implementation disparities across countries with varying governance capacity and resources
community_ownership: Collaborative model with government agencies, civil society organizations, and international partners

government_partnerships.nature: Data collection and beneficial ownership register reform
Support for beneficial ownership transparency reform
Legal reform and beneficial ownership transparency expansion
Beneficial ownership data availability and extractive governance

ai_involvement: Limited - primarily uses data management and analysis tools rather than machine learning
